title: Extracellular Vesicles (EVs) derived from Hemangioma stem cells (HemSC)
description: In order to investigate the function and mechanism of HemSC-EVs, we performed RNA-seq of HemSC-EVs which were extracted from cell culture supernatant of HemSC. Overall design: HemSC-EVs were extracted form cell culture supernatant of HemSC by ultra-centrifuge method. Then RNA-seq was conducted for HemSC-EVs

runs.experiment_title: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing: GSM7449624: HemSC-EVs-Transcriptome Homo sapiens RNA-Seq
